Title: Verify current logged-in user cannot be deleted
Test Data: Target User ID = Current User ID
Steps: 1. Attempt to delete the currently logged in user account.
Expected Result: Request is rejected. Current user is not deleted.

Title: Verify default admin user cannot be deleted
Steps: 1. Attempt to delete the default admin user account.
Expected Result: Request is rejected. Default admin is not deleted.

Title: Verify system user username must be unique
Steps: 1. Attempt to create a new user with an existing username.
Expected Result: Request is rejected with message 'Already exists'.

Title: Verify system user can be created with valid data
Steps: 1. Send POST request with valid user data.

Title: Verify username length validation
Steps: 1. Attempt to create user with short username.
Expected Result: Request is rejected with length validation error.

Title: Verify uploading new job specification replaces the old one
Steps: 1. Upload a new specification file for the job title.

Title: Verify organization root node cannot be deleted
Steps: 1. Attempt to delete the organization root node.
Expected Result: Request is rejected. Root node cannot be deleted.

Title: Verify Pay Grade min salary cannot exceed max salary
Steps: 1. Attempt to set min salary greater than max salary.
Expected Result: Request is rejected. Error Min < Max is shown.

Title: Verify Job Title must be unique
Steps: 1. Attempt to create a new job title with an existing name.
Expected Result: Request is rejected with unique validation error.

Title: Verify creating System User with non-existent Employee ID is rejected
Preconditions: Employee ID 99999 does not exist in PIM
Steps: 1. Send POST request to create System User with empNumber 99999.
Expected Result: Request is rejected. User is not created due to invalid employee reference.

Title: Verify newly created Job Title is available for assignment in PIM
Preconditions: Admin and PIM modules are accessible
Steps: 1. Create a new Job Title in Admin. 2. Fetch the list of allowed Job Titles when adding/editing PIM Job Details.
Expected Result: The newly created Job Title appears in the PIM selection list.

Title: Verify System User disabled state prevents login
Preconditions: System User exists and is enabled
Steps: 1. Admin updates the System User status to Disabled. 2. Attempt to login with that user's credentials.
Expected Result: Login is rejected with message 'Account disabled'.

Title: Configure system structure and job titles
Test Data: New Subunit name, New Job Title
Steps: 1. Navigate to Organization -> Structure. 2. Add a new subunit. 3. Navigate to Job -> Job Titles. 4. Add a new job title with specification.
Expected Result: Subunit and Job Title are created and visible in their respective lists.

Title: Manage System Users
Preconditions: Logged in as Admin, Employee exists in PIM.
Steps: 1. Navigate to User Management -> Users. 2. Add a new user linked to an existing employee. 3. Search for the created user. 4. Edit the user's role.
